def test_encode():
    # Basic cases from known behavior
    assert encode('test') == 'TGST'
    assert encode('This is a message') == 'tHKS KS C MGSSCGG'

    # Empty string
    assert encode('') == ''

    # Mixed-case vowels: swapcase first, then vowel shift
    assert encode('aEiOu') == 'CgKqW'

    # No vowels — only case swap happens
    assert encode('xyz XYZ') == 'XYZ xyz'

    # Vowels and consonants mixed
    assert encode('hello world') == 'HGLLQ wQrld'

    # Non-letter characters pass through unchanged
    assert encode('a1! b2?') == 'C1! B2?'

    # Single vowel
    assert encode('a') == 'C'
    assert encode('A') == 'c'

    # Consecutive vowels
    assert encode('aaee') == 'CCGG'

    # String with only consonants
    assert encode('bcdfg') == 'BCDFG'

def test_encode():
    # Basic vowel replacement + swapcase
    assert encode('test') == 'TGST'
    assert encode('hello') == 'HGLLQ'
    assert encode('Hello World') == 'hGLLQ wQRLD'

    # Empty string
    assert encode('') == ''

    # No vowels, only case swap
    assert encode('xyz') == 'XYZ'
    assert encode('XYZ') == 'xyz'

    # Only vowels
    assert encode('aeiou') == 'CGKQW'
    assert encode('AEIOU') == 'cgkqw'

    # Mixed case vowels
    assert encode('aA') == 'Cc'
    assert encode('Ee') == 'gG'

    # Digits and punctuation unchanged (aside from no case change)
    assert encode('1234!@#') == '1234!@#'

    # Numbers with letters
    assert encode('a1b2c3') == 'C1B2C3'

    # Repeated characters
    assert encode('aaa') == 'CCC'

    # Spaces preserved
    assert encode('a e i o u') == 'C G K Q W'
